what: The pair sheets and contact sheets of the Ridge Encounters edition, moved out of this repository and kept as release assets: one zip per batch, holding that batch's whole folder.
why: They are 1.3 GB of rendered output. Every clone of this repository paid for them, and the selection they supported is finished. The batch JSONs stay here, so what was kept, culled and rescued is still recorded in the repository; only the images moved.
rebuild: cd projects/028-ridge-encounters/edition && for b in batch-*/; do zip -r -X -q "${b%/}.zip" "$b"; done
verify: Unzip an asset and compare each file's sha256 against contents below. listing_sha256 is the sha256 of that batch's '<sha256> <file> <bytes>' lines, sorted by file, joined by newlines.
source_commit_note: Hashes are of the files as tracked at the commit that adds this manifest.
